Hospitality

The details of hospitality. Connected.

Hospitality operating system

Address12

Proprietary hospitality software

  • Product strategy
  • UX/UI
  • Software engineering
  • Automation

The challenge

Bring reservations, guest records, billing, documents and day-to-day property administration into one coherent system.

The strategy

Start with the operator’s workflow: know what is available, capture a booking, prepare the invoice and keep the guest record connected.

Design & engineering

The application source connects reservations and rates, guest records, invoices, expenses, payroll, communications and reporting. A Windows service supports the web interface. The dashboard shown here is rendered from the actual 10.3.2 components using a demonstration dataset.

The delivery

A proprietary hospitality management application, developed through operator feedback and ongoing refinement. Demonstrations can be arranged to discuss the workflows relevant to your property.

From booking to back office.

Room and rate management support reservations. Guest records connect the stay to billing and communications. Expenses, payroll and reporting bring the operational picture into the same interface.

Address12 is a local application, so its private operator environment is not linked from this portfolio. Request a demonstration to explore the relevant workflows.
